headline: Conservation Commission to review culvert cleanout at 451 Black Brook Drive, CSX herbicide plan, and tree-cutting violation at 4 Epirus Drive.
summary: The Commission will consider a request from Winnco to clean out a culvert at 451 Black Brook Drive and a request from CSX Transportation to use herbicide for weed control along the Lowell Train Track Right-Of-Way. It will also address an Enforcement Order against Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat for cutting trees near a wetland buffer at 4 Epirus Drive.
items: Request for Determination of Applicability: Winnco, 451 Black Brook Drive, 01851 - approval to clean out existing culvert within 100-foot wetland buffer zone

Enforcement Order: Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat, 4 Epirus Drive, 01854 - violation for cutting trees within 100 feet of a Bordering Vegetated Buffer (BVW)

October 8, 2026 
 
 
In accordance with the Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 131, Section 40, and the City of Lowell 
Wetland Ordinance Section 280.1 -13, the Lowell Conservation Commission  will hold a meeting on 
Wednesday, October 14, 2026 at 6:30 PM in-person in the City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street, 
Lowell MA 01852.  
 
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street,  Lowell MA 01852 
with public welcome and by using remote participation as follows: Members of the public may 
view the meeting via ltc.org or local cable channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific 
agenda item shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov mbrundage@lowellma.gov AND pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov indicating 
the agenda item and a phone number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the 
meeting. If no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978 -674-4144. All 
requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
Review the project materials online at: https://lowellma.gov/1100/Conservation-Commission
